about: T3.2's case-format changes (design choice 1; the dry run's gaps; the S2 test authors' gaps added to T3.2's brief on 2026-10-22) that both case loaders must refuse, and ones both must take: contract/runners/run_python.py's load_cases (tests/test_t32_case_format.py) and sdm-testkit's case::load (rust/crates/sdm-testkit/tests/t32_case_format.rs). Each change is applied to 'case', an S2 case on the Databricks SQL warehouse: every 'set' item sets the value at its path (a list of keys and positions, a missing key added), then every 'remove' path is taken out. The fields: 'warehouses', the warehouse legs an S2 case runs on and only there, one to four of databricks-sql, databricks-spark, snowflake and lakebase, never beside 'databases' and never on an S0 or S1 case; 'input.view', a metric or semantic view (its kind, its name, and its YAML or none for an existing view, a name possibly a placeholder the capture resolves, and trust_expressions, the boolean the reference's semantic_model(name, trust_expressions=) takes); 'input.connect', the connect path the source is opened by (warehouse, spark, snowpark or lakebase); and 'input.materialize.num_context_samples', the reference's materialize(num_context_samples=), any JSON scalar but null as materialize's other options that the reference itself checks. Unknown keys inside 'view' are refused as everywhere in the format.
